truth: Sugar, wheat flour, vegetable fats (palm, palm kernel), hazelnuts puree (9,5%), whole milk powder, cocoa butter, cocoa mass, corn starch, whey powder (milk), emulsifiers (ammonium phosphatides, soy lecithin, polyglycerol polyricinoleate), salt, skimmed milk powder, cocoa powder, egg white powder, flavourings, raising agents (ammonium hydrogen carbonate, sodium hydrogen carbonate). May contain traces of other nuts and peanuts.
